compiled_state.author: Test
compiled_state.description:
testing_mode: GREEN

## What
Author three documentation artifacts that freeze the ack event format and enumerate degradation consumers. These docs are the source of truth for all downstream consumers; they must be created before any consumer implementation can proceed.

## Files to Create / Modify
- plugins/dso/docs/contracts/ack-event-format.md — NEW. FROZEN marker. Five fields: decision_ids (array of decision_id strings), if_skipped (bool), timestamp (epoch ms), sampled_set (array of decision_id strings, subset of decision_ids that were sampled for this ack), schema_version (int, starts at 1). Include format example and field-level constraints.
- plugins/dso/docs/precondition-degradation-consumers.md — NEW. Enumerate all components that read or act on data.degradation/data.degradation_type: harvest-worktree.sh, dso:completion-verifier, sprint Step 10a, preconditions-validator.sh, _api.py. For each: what they read and what action they take on degradation=true.
- plugins/dso/docs/contracts/preconditions-schema-v2.md — UPDATE. Add section documenting data.degradation (bool, optional, default false) and data.degradation_type (string enum: inferred_decision | unresolved_question, optional, present only when degradation=true). Null-coalescing contract: readers must not reject events where these fields are absent.

## Acceptance Criteria
- ack-event-format.md contains FROZEN marker, all 5 fields documented with types and constraints
- precondition-degradation-consumers.md lists all 5 consumer components with read/action descriptions
- preconditions-schema-v2.md updated with data.degradation and data.degradation_type subsections
- Verify command: grep -l 'FROZEN' plugins/dso/docs/contracts/ack-event-format.md && grep -c 'harvest-worktree' plugins/dso/docs/precondition-degradation-consumers.md

## Done Definitions
- DD3: ack event format FROZEN in contract doc (immutable from this point)
- DD4: consumer manifest lists all 5 components with read/action descriptions
- No code changes — docs only

GAP_ANALYSIS_AMENDMENT: Additional acceptance criteria from gap analysis:

1. ack-event-format.md must include the decision_id format spec: '<session_id>:<sha256_of_decision_text[:16]>' with a frozen example — since all fields reference decision_ids, the format must be self-contained in the doc.

2. preconditions-schema-v2.md update must add a 'Reserved data sub-keys' subsection naming 'degradation' and 'degradation_type' with their types, to prevent future schema-v3 callers from colliding with these keys. This is required for DD2 (backwards compat guarantee).
